fit_reason: Whole 18-foot pontoon boat on trailer offered by a private owner.
findings: Pontoon logs look dull and stained along the lower tubes in the side shot
Aluminum fence panels and rails at the bow look dull and weathered
Cleaning bottles and clutter sitting on the front deck in the bow photo
Vinyl seats look mostly clean but show light grime in the seams and piping
Carpeted deck looks dusty and faded around the console and seats
Faded tan plastic on the console and seat bases
message: Hi, we saw your Sun Tracker Bass Buggy listing. The seats look in good shape, and a pre-sale detail could brighten up the dull pontoon logs and fence panels and freshen the vinyl and deck carpet for buyers. We come to you. Would you like a quote?
